primary_query: how to explain what you do as a consultant author and speaker
search_intent: Explain multifaceted work clearly, with usable introductions and bios.
target_buyer: Established woman with consulting, authorship, or speaking expertise and an unclear public message.
distinct_point_of_view: A clear introduction depends on prioritizing audience and expertise before listing delivery formats.
direct_answer_requirement: Start with who you help and the specific result you help them achieve. Then explain how your consulting, writing, and speaking support that work. Use one clear sentence for the value of your expertise and a second for how people can work with you. Add a relevant example or credential when the conversation calls for it.
